correctness.rationale: The face condition yields two contractible cones on simplex skeletons; their pushout is a suspension of the join. The augmented chain kernel gives the integral exterior-power augmentation lattice, Mayer–Vietoris and the graded join twist produce the exact swap sign. Orbit-barycenter triangulation proves the fixed-space type. Finite quotient rational homology is invariants; minimal-boundary eigenspace decomposition proves the projective-suspension quotient and 2-torsion. Replayed checker found exact predicted Betti groups in 46 finite tests and exact signed Lefschetz numbers in 10; all-order deductions are given independently.

value.rationale: The natural sharpness family for tolerance-complex Leray theory receives its complete all-size integral symmetry module, geometric fixed-space classification and explicit geometric quotient torsion. The coefficient-field change from a torsion-free sphere to a projective-suspension quotient is an intrinsic topological effect of a canonical block symmetry, relevant to invariant constructions and not a random computational slice. It extends beyond the known minimal sphere and t=1 special case, without claiming a general theorem for arbitrary chordal complexes.
